description: Call any Qase REST endpoint directly, for the few things no dedicated tool covers: method, a /v1/… path on the configured host, optional body or query. Prefer a dedicated tool where one exists — they normalize enums and validate before spending a call. JSON only; uploads go through qase_attachment_upload. A DELETE asks for confirmation like the dedicated delete tools. Cost: one API call, 0.3-1.5s.

path.description: API path starting with a version segment (e.g., "/v1/project/DEMO/run")

name: qase_api
title: Call Qase API
